# flint

> A component registry for GPUIX. Copy the source into your app, style it with tokens, keep it.

## Docs

- [Installation](https://wshrx.github.io/flint-ui/docs/installation/): install the CLI, init, provider, add
- [CLI](https://wshrx.github.io/flint-ui/docs/cli/): init, add, list, diff, flags, exit codes
- [Registry](https://wshrx.github.io/flint-ui/docs/registry/): registry.json format and validation
- [Theming](https://wshrx.github.io/flint-ui/docs/theming/): tokens, light and dark palettes
- [Versioning](https://wshrx.github.io/flint-ui/docs/versioning/): packages, docs archives, release policy
- [License](https://wshrx.github.io/flint-ui/docs/license/): MIT, third-party credits
